physicalNotes: Radius 0.3800524 Jupiter radii from Mancini et al. 2026 (2026A&A...712A.147M), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...712A.147M/abstract): 27,170.7 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. GM from the mass 0.07582708 Jupiter masses (Mancini et al. 2026, the mass the NASA Exoplanet Archive's composite table adopts (2026A&A...712A.147M), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive, https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...712A.147M/abstract) times JPL's Jupiter GM. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.
